_notes.purpose: Export cropped and average-binned 256x256 uint16 images using the per-camera hooks.
_notes.full_image: Set crop_enabled=false to preserve full frames without image hooks. Use a separate output directory.
_notes.pixels: Cropping and average binning produce a derived dataset. Integer binning rounds averaged counts; no normalization is applied.
_notes.out_dir: Use a distinct output directory for each export variant.
_notes.hooks.image: cam1: 1024/4; cam2: 768/3; cam3: 1024/4. Coordinates and factors are defined in hooks.image.
_notes.hooks.metadata: stats and centroid measure stored pixels. crop_energy measures the original frame using the configured camera crop.
_notes.sync_alignment: sample_id groups frames by the selected timestamp and tolerance. frame_sample_id is the per-camera frame_index + 1.

extra_info.pipeline: cam1 crop 1024/4; cam2 crop 768/3; cam3 crop 1024/4; all uint16 256x256
